dovezi.text: [Date deschise](https://harta-firmelor.ro/date): cifrele agregate ale registrului în CSV, licență CC BY 4.0
Extragerea automată și în masă a datelor de pe site nu este permisă.

nota: The open-data page of the project, linked from its llms.txt. It lists eight CSV files with their rows, period, measured-at date, sources and a dictionary of columns. The page is a copy that the owner saved from their browser (inventory.py --import-saved): the site answers every automated request with HTTP 429 and forbids automated extraction. No CSV file was downloaded and no request was made to harta-firmelor.ro or its API. The page declares no column type, so none is recorded.
